supervisor_child_args.isolation: Each supervisor instance can use independent --db, --repo, --worktree-root for full isolation

process_lifecycle.supervisor_a: Started via cmd_supervisor_start with CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP | DETACHED_PROCESS
process_lifecycle.supervisor_b: Started after lease expiry of A, uses same isolated database
process_lifecycle.termination: Hard kill via OS process termination (not graceful shutdown) for crash testing
process_lifecycle.cleanup: LivenessOrchestrator reclaims stale artifacts on startup
